query:
SELECT 
  SUBSTRING(url, 1, 60) as url_prefix,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM media_items
WHERE url IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY SUBSTRING(url, 1, 60)
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 20;
